text: Note that if you just want to register the marriage, you can do a walk-in at any time (you don't have to go in early) - it is done at the registry department and not the visa one. For this, usually the foreign partner doesn't have to be there (though you should have their passport or a photocopy of it). The visa department may want you to do this first, before converting your file. You can also request an appointment to convert your file by email.
